description: Juniper Junos CLI (operational and configuration mode). Only an explicit list of show commands is read; configuration dumps (`show configuration`, bare `show`, `show system login`, `| display`, `save`) are secret_read; pivots, shells and unknown lines are blocked or write_risky (fail-closed).

rules.pattern: ^show (?:version|system (?:uptime|information|alarms|storage|commit|users|processes extensive|memory|boot-messages)|interfaces(?: terse| brief| descriptions| extensive| [a-z]{2,3}-\d+/\d+/\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?|route(?: summary| \S+)?|chassis (?:hardware|alarms|environment|routing-engine|fpc|firmware)|arp(?: no-resolve)?|bgp (?:summary|neighbor)|ospf (?:neighbor|interface|database)|lldp neighbors|ethernet-switching (?:table|interface)|vlans|log \S+|ntp (?:associations|status)|security (?:flow session summary|zones|policies hit-count))(?: \| (?:match|except|count|no-more|last|find)\b[^|>]*)*$

^(?:show(?: configuration| system login| system root-authentication| snmp| security (?:ike|ipsec|keychain|pki)| groups)?(?: .*)?|run show configuration.*|file (?:show|archive|copy)\b.*|request system configuration rescue\b.*|save\b.*)$
rules.hint: Configuration dumps and secrets are never shown in the console.
